name: Sharbat
description: Fruit or herb syrup diluted with cold water — vinegar and mint in the case of sekanjabin.

unani.note: Thanda-tar; sharbat is a Unani category, not just a drink.

histamine.note: The vinegar-based sekanjabin rates higher than the fruit ones.

nutrition.highlight: a Unani category, not just a drink
